name: EU/EEA Free Movement

qualifying_event.description: Norway is an EEA member (via EFTA, not the EU). EU/EEA nationals have the right to live, work, and study in Norway without a residence permit, though registration with the police/UDI is generally required for stays beyond a short period.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Valid EU/EEA passport or national ID; registration certificate; proof of employment, self-employment, sufficient means, or study status.

requirements.blocker_text: Only EU/EEA nationals qualify for free movement into Norway under this route.

Right of residence requires employment/self-employment, sufficient means and insurance (if economically inactive), or student status -- consistent with the general EU/EEA free-movement framework, though the UDI page fetched in this pass did not spell out the specific registration deadline or exact self-sufficiency figures for Norway.

sources.title: UDI -- Residence under the EU/EEA regulations: confirms EU/EEA nationals' right to live, work and study in Norway, notes much of the detailed content is Norwegian-language only

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway).
